name: GXR-5 Sabotage Droid
description: GXR-5 Sabotage Droid was a battle droid of the Galactic Republic active during the Cold War. In 3643 BBY it was aboard the Thranta-class corvette Brentaal Star during the attack by the Gage-class transport Black Talon. GXR-5 boarded the vessel, but was destroyed by the Imperials aboard.
